items.stem: Why should a persuasive essay address counterarguments?

options.text: It strengthens your case by answering likely objections
options.rationale: Correct: rebutting objections makes an argument more convincing.

options.text: It lets you avoid giving any evidence
options.rationale: You still need evidence for your own claims.

options.text: It is only there to fill up space
options.rationale: Counterarguments serve a real persuasive purpose.

options.text: It proves the other side is always right
options.rationale: You address objections in order to answer them, not concede.

items.explanation: Correct: rebutting objections makes an argument more convincing.

items.stem: Which TWO practices help you use sources responsibly? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Citing where each idea or quotation came from
options.rationale: Correct: citation credits the source and avoids plagiarism.

options.text: Putting another writer's exact words in quotation marks
options.rationale: Correct: quotation marks signal borrowed wording.

options.text: Copying a passage and changing one word
options.rationale: Near-copying without credit is still plagiarism.

options.text: Presenting a source's idea as entirely your own
options.rationale: Claiming others' ideas as your own is plagiarism.

items.explanation: Correct: citation credits the source and avoids plagiarism.
